Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent four-form evolution design sheet for a new companion in NABO Words. Input image is a STYLE/FAMILY REFERENCE ONLY: Doudou, the existing green bean/leaf mascot. Do not copy Doudou's leaves or its green color. New creature must look like Doudou's sibling: same round bean-shaped body proportions, huge dark oval eyes with ONE small cream highlight each, tiny curved smile, two peach cheek dots, two short rounded feet, dark local-color outline, clean solid flat fills with only one main cel shadow. Innocent cozy 2D cartoon. No soft3D, painterly texture, grain, gradient, sticker-white outline, scenery, cast shadow or text.
Exactly FOUR isolated forms left to right: closed decorated EGG with no face; round BABY; TEEN gaining identifying features and two short arms; FINAL keeping the same face/body but completed species features and one simple graduation motif. Shared eye design and anatomy in all three living stages. Heights approximately28:32:40:48. All share one bottom baseline. Landscape sheet with FOUR equal-width quarters; each form fully contained inside its quarter with generous transparent spacing; no overlapping, extra forms, loose decorative particles, captions, labels, panels or measurement marks. Small silhouette and broad shapes must remain legible at28/32/40/48px. Transparent alpha background. Finite color palette under24 colors, no thin detail. Species: PAOPAO, playful SKY-BLUE water-drop/bubble spirit. Outline dark desaturated blue. Egg is pale ice-blue shell with TWO broad blue water-drop markings. Baby is a light sky-blue round bean with one small rounded water-drop point on top. Teen gains a taller gently curling water-drop crest and two small droplet arms. Final keeps the same bean face and drop crest, with a compact bubble-ring HALO directly over its head (distinct graduation motif) and two small side droplet fins. Halo is one simple thick blue/cream oval ring, not a gold crown. Keep bubble motif opaque flat blues rather than glass transparency/gloss. No leaf features.
